source_records.title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (Defossez et al., 2024)
source_records.summary_text: First real-time full-duplex speech-text LLM: parallel user/system streams, Mimi streaming codec (80ms frame), Inner Monologue; theoretical 160ms / ~200ms practice latency; open weights. Foundational latency methodology for G10. [retrieval: SUMMARY_CAPTURED; full-body consumption at Evidence stage]
